title: Handelsgesetzbuch (HGB) §§ 289b to 289e and §§ 315b to 315c: non-financial statement (nichtfinanzielle Erklärung)
citation: HGB §§ 289b-289e and 315b-315c, inserted by the CSR-Richtlinie-Umsetzungsgesetz of 11 April 2017 (BGBl. I S. 802)
evidence: CSR-Richtlinie-Umsetzungsgesetz, BGBl. 2017 I Nr. 20, ausgegeben zu Bonn am 18. April 2017 (S. 802), Article on Inkrafttreten: "(1) Dieses Gesetz tritt vorbehaltlich des Absatzes 2 am Tag nach der Verkündung in Kraft." (Absatz 2: Artikel 2 und 4 on 1 January 2019.) Opened https://www.bgbl.de/xaver/bgbl/start.xav?startbk=Bundesanzeiger_BGBl&jumpTo=bgbl117s0802.pdf (PDF, 13 pages) on 2026-11-02.
notes: Record text is §§ 289b, 289c, 289d, 289e, 315b and 315c of the HGB as consolidated by the Federal Office of Justice (Stand of the HGB: Zuletzt geändert durch Art. 4 G v. 4.2.2026 I Nr. 33). The six sections carry no footnote with an amendment date, so the record is dated 2017-04-19, the first in-force date, on this basis: the wording of the six sections was compared with the CSR-RUG as published (BGBl. 2017 I S. 802) and the differences found were layout of the PDF (numbering of paragraphs, page breaks), not words; this is a comparison of 8-word runs, not a legal check that no later amendment touched them. gesetze-im-internet.de serves only the current consolidation (Hinweise page, item 3), so the versions between adoption and the stored state are not stored; no earlier consolidation was found on the site. The HGB is not an instrument stored whole: only the six sections are. Regime: the pre-CSRD non-financial statement; the CSRD-Umsetzungsgesetz is not promulgated (register row in F7, nothing stored). English: the Translations list (https://www.gesetze-im-internet.de/Teilliste_translations.html, opened 2026-11-02) has no entry for this instrument. The list has an HGB entry (Books 1 to 4, ministry language service, updated by Samson-Übersetzungen GmbH, Book 3 holds these sections), but its row DE-GII-TRANSLATION is permission requested, so it is not stored and not listed in source_row.

title: Bundes-Klimaschutzgesetz (KSG)
citation: KSG of 12 December 2019 (BGBl. I S. 2513), as amended by the Acts of 18 August 2021 (BGBl. I S. 3905) and 15 July 2024 (BGBl. 2024 I Nr. 235)
evidence: Footnote on the first norm of the consolidated text: "Das G wurde als Artikel 1 des G v. 12.12.2019 I 2513 vom Bundestag beschlossen. Es ist gem. Art. 4 dieses G am 18.12.2019 in Kraft getreten." The Act was issued on 17 December 2019 (BGBl. 2019 I Nr. 48) and its Inkrafttreten article reads "Dieses Gesetz tritt am Tag nach der Verkündung in Kraft." Opened https://www.gesetze-im-internet.de/ksg/xml.zip and https://www.bgbl.de/xaver/bgbl/start.xav?startbk=Bundesanzeiger_BGBl&jumpTo=bgbl119s2513.pdf on 2026-11-02.
notes: Two records: the Act as published in 2019 (all articles, 9 pages, dated 2019-12-18) and the consolidated KSG dated 2024-07-17, the in-force date of the Second Amending Act (BGBl. 2024 I Nr. 235 of 16 July 2024, Art. 2: 'Dieses Gesetz tritt am Tag nach der Verkündung in Kraft', read in the PDF at https://www.recht.bund.de/bgbl/1/2024/235/regelungstext.pdf). The consolidated state is 'Zuletzt geändert durch Art. 1 G v. 15.7.2024 I Nr. 235'. The 2021 state (Act of 18 August 2021, BGBl. I S. 3905) is not stored: only the current consolidation is served. The amending acts of 2021 and 2024 are not separate entries. English: the Translations list has a KSG entry (Language Service of the Federal Ministry for Economic Affairs and Climate Action) whose Stand names the 2021 and 2024 amendments, which matches the stored 2024-07-17 state; it is not stored because row DE-GII-TRANSLATION is permission requested (private, non-commercial use only), and so the row is not in source_row. English page: https://www.gesetze-im-internet.de/englisch_ksg/index.html. The adopted PDF was fetched with a headless browser (see SOURCES.md).
